resizeInspectorHint: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
modCount: {count} mods · Local files, under your control
appUpdateRestartHint: The app will close and restart to finish installing. Your mod library is not affected.
loadingLibraryHint: Reading mod folders. Large libraries can take a moment.
emptyTitle: A fresh start for your library
noResultsHint: Try a different name or author.
emptyHint: Add a mod folder, or choose your inZOI Mods folder in Settings to discover installed mods.
stagingLocationHint: The app uses a .inzoimm-staging folder here. Changing this location moves the existing staging files. Leave blank to use the location next to the game’s Mods folder.
externalNote: Disabling or removing this installed mod first saves a copy in your Managed mods folder.
selectMod: Select a mod to view details
settingsHint: Choose folders for installed mods and Managed mods.
updateHint: Updates from coolbirdzik/inzoi-better-mod-manager must have a valid signature.
setNxmHandler: Use this app for Vortex links
linkHint: Paste an nxm://inzoi/… link from Nexus Mods. Links for other games are rejected.
apiKeyHint: Your key is remembered securely on this device and sent only to the official Nexus API. Free accounts need an unexpired Download with Manager link.
languageHint: English is the default. Changes apply immediately and are remembered on this device.
folderImported: Mods added to the library. Enable them when you want to install them in the game.
adoptConfirm: Back up “{name}” to the library and let this app manage its installed copy?
adopted: Backed up and took control of the installed mod.
removeConfirm: Remove “{name}” from the library and game? The files will move to the system Trash.
downloadComplete: File downloaded to private storage. Review it before importing.
desktopRequired: Open the desktop app to access your local library.
copied: Copied to the private library. The existing installation was kept.
nxmConfirm: Use this app for nxm links instead of the currently registered application?
nxmRegistered: Registered this app to receive inZOI nxm links.
downloadImported: Imported the mod downloaded from Nexus.
gameFilesLocked: Could not change “{name}” because its files are in use, usually because inZOI is running. Quit inZOI and try again.
scanSubfoldersHint: Find mods in all subfolders. Turn off to scan only the selected folder.
managedFolderHint: Scan this folder for library. Files stay in place; mods already managed remain listed.
nexusApiKeyGuide: Open the Nexus API keys page, copy your API key, then paste it here.
nexusApiKeyRequired: Enter your Nexus API key before downloading.
sourceNote: Enable to use this mod in game. Its library files stay in this source folder.
downloadQueueHint: Downloads run in the background. Nexus and CurseForge ZIP mods are added to your library automatically.
queuePausedHint: The current download will finish. Waiting downloads are paused.
archiveExtractionHint: This file is saved in your library as an archive. Only ZIP, 7z and RAR archives can be installed; open its folder to extract other formats manually.
noDownloadsHint: Use Download with Manager on Nexus, or paste an inZOI Nexus / CurseForge link above.
downloadFolderHint: Each mod gets a folder named after it and its Nexus ID, with separate files and versions inside. ZIP mods are added to library in place. Leave blank to use Downloads inside your managed folder.
downloadConfirmHint: Download this file and add its mods to library?
managedCollectionHint: Enable a mod to use it in game. Disabled mods stay in your library.
noSourceFoldersHint: Add folders from your computer with Add source folders.
searchSourcesHint: Try another folder name or path.
sourceDetachHint: Removing a source keeps its files on your computer.
nexusKeyLoadFailed: Could not read the saved Nexus API key. You can enter it again.
nexusKeySaveFailed: Could not save or remove the Nexus API key on this device. Your current key can still be used for this session.
archiveLibraryHint: Saved in your library, not installed. Install adds mods with mod_manifest.json to the library and copies legacy PAK files into ~mods (disabled). Archives with the inZOI Mod Enabler are installed into the game folder after confirmation.
curseforgeApiKeyGuide: Direct downloads require a CurseForge for Studios API key with access to inZOI. Request a key in the developer console.
curseforgeApiKeyHint: Saved in the operating system credential store, separately from Nexus. Some authors disable third-party downloads.
curseforgeApiKeyRequired: Enter your CurseForge API key in Settings.
curseforgeKeyLoadFailed: Could not read the saved CurseForge API key.
curseforgeKeySaveFailed: Could not save or clear the CurseForge API key. The entered key still works in this session.
curseforgeDownloadHint: Download this file, or the latest release when using a mod page. ZIP mods are added to your library disabled.
modUpToDate: This mod is up to date.
modUpdateManualHint: The installed file or matching variant could not be verified. Open the source page to choose the right update.
modUpdateUnsupported: No supported download source was found for this mod.
modUpdateKeepsPrevious: The previous version is kept. Enabled mods stay enabled; disabled mods stay disabled.
restoreModConfirm: Restore the previous version of “{name}”? Its current enabled/disabled state will be kept.
nexusUpdateDownloadHint: Nexus direct downloads require Premium. Free accounts can open the file page and use Download with Manager; the matching link will update this mod.
checkLogHint: The last 500 checks are saved on this device. API keys and signed URL parameters are removed.
checkLogMissingKey: Missing API key. Add the key for this source in Settings.
checkLogUnauthorized: HTTP 401: the source rejected the API key.
checkLogForbidden: HTTP 403: access denied. Check that this source key has access to the game.
checkLogNotFound: HTTP 404: the source project or file is unavailable.
checkLogRateLimit: HTTP 429: too many requests. Wait before checking again.
checkLogTimeout: The request timed out. Try again later.
checkLogNetwork: Could not connect. Check the network, TLS certificate, or proxy.
checkLogBackendMismatch: The desktop backend does not match the interface. Restart the desktop app after updating.
checkLogMissingMod: This mod is no longer in the library.
checkLogCopyFallback: Clipboard unavailable. Select and copy the text below.
checkLogEmpty: No checks recorded yet. Run Check mod updates. Earlier checks were not saved.
discoveryHint: Choose which drives to scan, then scan them for inZOI mods, including moved Vortex staging and download folders. Quick scan only checks the usual Vortex and download locations. Progress shows the current path; you can stop and keep partial results. Network shares can be selected with Scan a folder. Scanning only reads files; supported mods contain mod_manifest.json.
discoveryEmpty: No extracted mods found. Supported mod folders contain mod_manifest.json. Legacy PAK/UE4SS packages are not supported.
discoveryVortexHint: Adding a source remembers its location without moving files. Vortex mods may include undeployed versions; the Vortex profile is not imported. Avoid managing the same mod in both apps at once.
discoverySuggest: These Vortex / Nexus Mods folders hold your installed Nexus mods. Add them as source folders to manage them here.
appUpdateLibraryAvailable: Your mod library is still available. You can retry the app update later.
onboardingIntro: To download and update mods, this app uses an API key from Nexus Mods and CurseForge. You can skip this step: features for a provider without a key simply won't work until you add its key in Settings.
onboardingNeedBoth: You can skip now and add keys later in Settings.
nxmHandlerMissing: This app is not set to open Vortex links
scanCancelled: Scan stopped. These are partial results; you can add the sources already found.
scanArchiveHint: Archives found in inZOI download locations. ZIP files can be imported; extract 7z/RAR manually. Files stay in place until you choose an action.
pakModsHint: Legacy PAK mods are .pak files in inZOI's Content/Paks/~mods folder. Detect finds the game, or pick the game folder or ~mods. Leave empty to turn this off.
legacyNote: This legacy PAK mod stays in the game’s ~mods folder. Disabling adds the _disabled suffix to its files. Removing moves them to the system Trash. Close inZOI before changing it.
pakNotFound: Could not find an inZOI install. Pick the game folder or ~mods instead.
legacyInstalled: {count} legacy PAK mod(s) copied to ~mods (disabled). Enable them under Legacy PAK mods.
legacyInstalledNoEnabler: {count} legacy PAK mod(s) copied to ~mods (disabled). Enable them under Legacy PAK mods. The inZOI Mod Enabler was not found in the game folder; PAK mods in ~mods only load with it.
modEnablerConfirm: This archive contains the inZOI Mod Enabler. Install it into the game folder (BlueClient/Binaries/Win64)? Files it replaces are kept in Content/.inzoimm-trash. Close inZOI first.
modEnablerInstalled: inZOI Mod Enabler installed into the game folder.
modEnablerStatusMissing: inZOI Mod Enabler: not found. Legacy PAK mods in ~mods need it to load.
modEnablerMissingNotice: Legacy PAK mods are installed, but the inZOI Mod Enabler was not found in the game folder. Install it from its downloaded archive so the game loads them.
modEnablerDeclined: Mod Enabler installation was cancelled. The archive was kept.
legacyPanelHint: Loose .pak/.utoc/.ucas mods in the game's ~mods folder. They are kept apart from mod_manifest.json mods and only load with the inZOI Mod Enabler. Close inZOI before changing them.
legacyEmptyHint: Install a ZIP, 7z or RAR that contains .pak files, or add a folder of loose PAK files. They are copied into ~mods disabled.
modEnablerNoFolder: Set the legacy PAK folder (~mods) in Settings to manage these mods.
installAsLegacyHint: Copy the package's .pak files into ~mods (disabled) instead of adding it to the library. Use this for mods that you want to load with the inZOI Mod Enabler.
